For axial and polar l=2 and real omega != 0, construct the exact order-by-order maps from the Ricci/curvature carriers to a declared metric gauge, including every compatibility equation, homogeneous Einstein ambiguity and residual-gauge quotient. Compute the complete Frobenius/Jordan recursion, prove existence or locate the first resonance obstruction, and print all logarithmic, r_* polynomial or generalized-eigenmode factors. State metric components in a regular tetrad and cross-check the leading orders against BH2C_METRIC_LEADING. Treat omega=0 separately through its certified carrier. Land exact sparse recursion data, an independent reconstruction verifier, decisive wrong-exponent and omitted-log mutations, and an atlas fragment. The result must either provide the all-orders formal metric reconstruction or the first exact obstruction in a complete declared reconstruction class.
